summary: US equities rebounded on Nov 9 after last week's AI/tech selloff, with futures supported by a stronger-than-expected October jobs report (4.1% unemployment, +0.4% m/m wages) that also raised questions about Fed easing. NVIDIA fell against the tech rally after its board opened an internal investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang. Crude fell sharply (WTI about -3.5%, Brent about -4.5%) and spot gold rose about 1.2% to near $4,118 on a softer dollar. US October CPI on Nov 10 is the key scheduled event this week. Coverage of non-US central banks, other megacaps, ETH, DAX and FTSE was not found within the 72h window.
